DOP: ababa n. and m ( fn ), 1. ( n. ) a certain high numeral (a koṭi 11 ) ; Abh 475 (ahahaṃ ~aṃ c’ evāṭaṭaṃ); Sadd 801, 27 (ahahaṃ ~aṃ aṭaṭaṃ); 802, 24 (vīsati nirabbudāni ekaṃ ~aṃ vīsati ~āni ekaṃ aṭaṭaṃ); — 2. ( m. ) the name of a hell, or place in Avīci , where one suffers for an ababa of years ; S I 152, 8 (seyyathā pi … vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evaṃ eko ~o nirayo) = A V 173, 12 = Sn p. 126, 15 .
CPD: ababa , n., name of a certain high numeral, viz. a koṭi 11 = 10 11 millions = 10 77 ; Abh 475 ≠ Kacc-v 397 (Sadd 801, 27 foll. ) - Pay fol. gu v. 3.
NCP: masculine the name of a hell, or place in Avīci, where one suffers for an ababa of years.
